Given that the chemo-mechanical degrada­ tion of the cathode is accelerated by the fluctuation in cell pressure, real- time pressure regulation can be helpful for stable cycling, e.g., spring- equipped ASSB assembly [55]. Furthermore, the design and construc­ tion of ASSBs with low-strain cathode materials and SE materials capable of accommodating mechanical stresses can minimize the cell degradation due to high-strain anodes. This study provides insights into the influence of high-strain anodes on the accelerated degradation of composite cathodes and will contribute to the development of sulfide-based ASSBs with a long cycle life.
